name: branding-news6-microphone-logo-black-pink-outline
title: 'news6' logo: a pink-and-white outline microphone forming the number 6 on black
whatItIs: A black square logo tile with a thin white microphone outline whose cord and head curl to form the shape of the number '6' in hot pink, above a lowercase 'news6' wordmark where the '6' matches the icon's pink accent.
whatItMeans: Clever and memorable; hiding the brand number inside the product icon (a mic) creates an instantly ownable mark.
techniques: Shape an icon so it doubles as a number or letter.
Match one accent colour between the icon and the wordmark.
Use thin outline strokes for a modern, light logo feel.

vocabulary.definition: Designing an icon to double as a letter or number shape.
A logo drawn using only line strokes, no fills.
